reference_snapshot.gate_semantics: Required completion states are observed together at a carrier reference. The gate remains OPEN while any state is unresolved and CLOSES only when every required state is directly evidenced complete.
reference_snapshot.passband_semantics: While the gate is OPEN, a new reference snapshot is reacquired after the configured carrier-reference delta even if state values are unchanged; state progress may trigger earlier reacquisition inside the passband.
reference_snapshot.historical_gate_passband_frequency_rule_: Historical GATE_PASSBAND_DERIVED carrier records remain immutable provenance. The label is retained prospectively only for snapshot reacquisition/monitoring, not oscillator progression.

execution_semantics.carrier_progression: The heartbeat exists and advances independently every 10 ms according to its oscillator. No repository event, workflow, worker, task, admission, claim, fence, route, credential, reference snapshot, or observation call causes or gates heartbeat progression.
execution_semantics.production: heartbeat_runtime.oscillator_producer.OscillatorProducer derives exact phase deadlines from the stable oscillator anchor. scripts/run_heartbeat_runtime.py wakes for those phase deadlines and only materializes the already-due reference.
execution_semantics.sampling: heartbeat_runtime.engine_v13.HeartbeatRuntime.cycle samples the oscillator-derived reference and persists an observation; it does not advance the heartbeat.
execution_semantics.snapshot_reacquisition: GATE_PASSBAND_DERIVED reacquires a new non-authorizing monitoring snapshot at the current carrier reference when required-state evidence changes or an unresolved monitoring passband is crossed. It never creates the carrier reference it observes.
execution_semantics.missed_references: A delayed producer/observer may observe a later heartbeat and compress any number of intermediate references into a bounded due-reference range. Those references existed by oscillator phase travel and are not retroactively created by the observer.
execution_semantics.worker_transition: WorkerCoordinator independently observes whichever carrier reference is visible when WorkerCoordinator executes. Independently admitted HANDOFF_READY work may be assigned without a carrier event. Worker observation is downstream evidence, never a prerequisite for the carrier reference to exist.

prohibited_substitutions: GitHub workflow event as heartbeat clock
claim or fence state as heartbeat clock
route or credential state as heartbeat clock
reference snapshot reacquisition as heartbeat clock
observation invocation count as heartbeat clock
third-party fallback promoted to required dependency or production authority
release_condition: Carrier semantics are correct when the canonical reference is produced only by the independent 10 ms oscillator, the resident carrier loop wakes from oscillator phase deadlines rather than repository/task events, persisted carrier state is explicitly an observation/sample, GATE_PASSBAND_DERIVED is limited to non-authorizing reference-snapshot reacquisition for completion monitoring, legacy HB29 remains immutable provenance, and downstream consumers cannot cause, delay, authorize or suppress heartbeat progression.
